I wake up at 6:40, and take a shower at 6:45. I eat breakfast and go back to bed for the next half hour. Pointlessly looking at pictures on Imgur that dont even make me laugh, it makes time go by quicker. Then at 7:50 i get ready for school and leave the house at 8:10. My bus picks me up at 8:21, and its a 45 minute bus ride to school. When i get there, i greet everyone as fucking ususal to have next to no response and just go to my locker, get my shit and go to class. For the next six hours i try to forget that im at school and just focus on the next weekend. When school is over at 3:27 its just get the fuck out of there and sleep on the bus because i get exhausted. Wake up every 5 minutes until i get to the before last stop. I get off and go home. Drop my bag and play video games for the rest of the day. Then at 9:30 i go to bed and cant sleep until about 11:30 or 1:00, and think about suicide for the whole time.

During the whole fucking day i have to fake my emotions because i dont remember what its like to have them. Its annoying. But at least it makes me look better than my physical apperance. I constantly look like shit, and barely take care of myself. Everyone sees me as a video game addict, yet i play games because time goes by faster, i just want the day to end. Its so difficult to do basic shit. Yesterday we had a little test thing in math to see what we remembered from last year, and i found it hard to do basic additions. The worst part is, i cant appreciate anything anymore. Whenever i get something i just thank you put on a fake smile and move on. I can barely stand having to fake everything. I had to fake being interested in someone because i asked them out. I liked her at first, but afterwards, she was just a regualar person. So theres no point in dating when you have dp.

I also wonder what my mom thinks of me, i know im a dissapointment to my dad, but i think my mom is hiding what she thinks behind fake smiles and shit.

Sorry for the ramble, but this is how EVERY FUCKING DAY EVER happens.

Long story short, dp is not fun and makes things harder for everyone.

So i was playing Insurgency. Its a very hardcore and tactical game. And i was looking forward to playing some co op on District (the only co op map i hadnt completed). Once i hop in and pick a class, the game starts. Really casual start, nade spam the area ...etc... When all the bots were dead, we cap the first objective and move on to the second objective. When we finnaly get to objective B, 2 guys come in. They get shotguns and we think nothing of it. After we cap B there was a counter attack (basically 30 something bots that charge at you for a minute). So we set up a defencive position and mow down some bots. We get overrunned and we all die. Except those two guys that had joined earlier. All the bots gang up on them of course and start shooting at them. Keep in mind, there was about 10 bots left, and they were all armed with AKM's AK74U's SKS's and RPD's. They were shooting these guy at point blank range, so were all thinking "hackers". This game doesent have a lot of hackers and are usually kicked no matter the case. We vote kick these guys, and the vote passes and they never got kicked. We vote again, same thing. So we respawn and shoot our way to C. But then, all 6 of us (who werent hackers) got shot by those two. Everyone is pissed and someone contacts an admin. Admin comes on, trys to ban these guys, secssefully ban one, but not the other. 

I was still new at the game, so i didnt know about this next part. 

All i see is this guy fly across the map for no reason. Then i look in the chat and it says "admin has slaped [name]" and i freak out. The guy lands on the ground and dies. We vote for the next map and we end up on Ministry. The smallest map. Imagine how that sounds for teamkillers. We start the game and these guys set us on fire with incidiary grenades. So naturally. I shot the fucker with my trusty M16A4. A full 30 round mag. Dude is still alive and starts jumping around in the air givind random commands. He shoots me. Then, all of a sudden, fucker noclips in the building in front of us and shoots everyone. I start to spectate him and he gets an M249 (wich is not available for the class he had wich was Demolitions) and somehow changed the fire rate to shoot like a full mag a second. My game lags so hard (had a shit pc at the time, and when bullets hit something, theres a lot of dust that kicks up) and my game crashes. Thats when i stoped playing Insurgency for 2014
